exposure: Different analgesic pathways for cesarean delivery: (1) neuraxial morphine + as needed analgesics, (2) continuous wound catheter infusions of local anesthetic + neuraxial morphine + as needed analgesics, (3) continuous wound catheter infusion + neuraxial morphine + scheduled non-opioid analgesics every 6h, (4) continuous wound catheter infusion + neuraxial morphine + scheduled non-opioid analgesics together every 6h
outcome: Cumulative and average daily opioid use for postoperative days (POD) 1-4
finding: The addition of enhanced recovery after cesarean (ERAC) protocols to a standardized multimodal analgesic regimen (local anesthetic wound infusion catheters and neuraxial morphine) for cesarean delivery significantly reduced postoperative opioid consumption.
